newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns baa1 to Asahi Bank preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns baa1 to Asahi Bank preferred stock.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had assigned a rating of baa1 to the 100 billion yen 50,000 units of AB International Cayman Trust, which represent non-cumulative mandatory convertible preference shares of Asahi Bank Ltd.
The rating is based primarily upon the credit quality of the underlying preferred stock issued by Asahi Bank, Moody's said in a statement.
Asahi's well-focused retail banking strategy will keep the bank on the leading edge, but challenges by the six largest city banks are likely to pressure its margins, it said.
Moody's also said that commercial real estate concentration in Asahi's loan portfolio remains large in relation to the bank's capital.
